archive_summary.deduplication_policy: one exact SHA-256 content group retained in Training, else Validation, else Testing

split_method: retained source archive folders after exact SHA-256 deduplication; not participant/session disjoint
participant_metadata: absent; generalization to unseen people is not measured
negative_examples: absent; false acceptance, rejection calibration, and unknown-sign handling are not measurable
digits: absent; this archive contains A-Z only
preprocessing: MediaPipe HandLandmarker, BGR JPEG decode then RGB conversion, up to two hands; inference time includes decode and hand landmark extraction

features.existing_local_hand_features: two normalized 21-point local hand vectors, zero padded, plus hand count/presence; current experimental pose_vector
features.local_features_plus_relative_two_hand_la: left-to-right canonical local vectors plus wrist displacement and scale ratio

classifier: StandardScaler + RBF SVC (C=1.0), no probability calibration, no rejection threshold
candidate_selection: higher validation macro-F1; test set used only for final reported comparison
model_approval: not approved for learner correctness or mastery; archive has no participant metadata or negative examples
latency_note: classifier timing is measured alone per test vector; feature latency includes local JPEG decode and MediaPipe landmark extraction on the current CPU

active_reference_heuristic_comparison.same_split_policy: one exact SHA-256 content group retained in Training, else Validation, else Testing
active_reference_heuristic_comparison.permitted_interpretation: image-disjoint letter candidate comparison only; not person-disjoint validation or assessment reliability
active_reference_heuristic_comparison.false_acceptance: not measurable: the archive has no labeled negative target examples
active_reference_heuristic_comparison.rejection_calibration: not measurable: the archive has no no-hand, incomplete, transition, or unknown-sign examples
